newsitem.title: INDIA: India oil, gas refinery shrs up before petrol news.
newsitem.headline: India oil, gas refinery shrs up before petrol news.

text.p: Indian oil and gas refinery stocks such as Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HPCL) Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL), Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC) and Gas Authority of India Ltd (GAIL) rose ahead of an anticipated rise in domestic petroleum product prices, dealers said.
Foreign funds were keen bidders in these stocks ahead of Sunday's meeting of the policy-making steering committee of India's ruling United Front, traders said.
BPCL rose 11.25 rupees to 398.0, HPCL 0.75 to 436.50 and ONGC 7.25 to 287.75 on the Bombay Stock Exchange. GAIL shares climbed 1.20 rupees to 175.20 at the National Stock Exchange.
The United Front steering committee has failed to reach any agreement in raising prices at two earlier meetings.
Oil and refinery stocks provide a defensive hedge against the negative influence of any increase in petroleum product prices.

Analysts say the long-delayed oil price hike is necessary if the government is to bridge the oil pool deficit -- the money the government owes oil companies for selling petroleum products well below international rates.
The oil pool deficit was estimated at 155 billion rupees ($4.33 billion) at the end of March, government figures show.
